{{CSGO}}: 2012-11-04 }} '''Natus Vincere''' (Latin for "born to win", often abbreviated to '''NAVI''' and previously '''Na`Vi''') is a [[:category:Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional esports organization.
They were the first team to win all [[Counter-Strike_Majors|''Counter-Strike'' Majors]] in one calendar year, with [[Intel_Extreme_Masters/Season_IV/World_Championship|Intel Extreme Masters IV]], [[Electronic_Sports_World_Cup/2010|ESWC 2010]], and [[World_Cyber_Games/2010|WCG 2010]], and the first team to win a [[Majors|''Global Offensive'' Major]] without dropping a map, doing so at [[PGL Major Stockholm 2021]].
